text: Figure 7.2: PeriodicEventTriggering Class PeriodicEventTriggering Package M2::AUTOSART emplates::CommonStructure::Timing::TimingConstraint::EventT riggeringConstraint Note The PeriodicEventT riggering describes the behavior of an event with a strict periodic occurrence pattern, given by the period attribute. Additionally , it is possible to soften the strictness of the periodic occurrence behavior by specifying a jitter, so that there can be a deviation from the period up to the size of the jitter.
